cohort: 165 patients with unexplained infertility and/or recurrent miscarriages who underwent myomectomy or septoplasty between September 2016 and October 2021
finding: In patients with unexplained infertility and recurrent miscarriage, hysteroscopic myomectomy, compared with hysteroscopic metroplasty, was significantly associated with higher spontaneous pregnancy, more term pregnancies, and less miscarriage rates.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the mode of delivery for patients who got pregnant postoperatively.
